name: 49913 · Calumet, MI
findings: ZIP 49913 (Calumet) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49913 (Calumet) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
